text:
Priya (Finance): Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need owners and timelines for the token-count spike remediation. Scope: delayed ingestion backfill, invoice corrections for 2 affected customers, and telemetry/alert gaps. Please ack and volunteer.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Ack. I can take the delayed ingestion backfill. I will need access to the raw S3 logs + tokenizer mapping to compute corrected token counts. ETA?

Maya (Billing): I will own invoice corrections and credit memos. Need Ashwin's final corrected counts by Tue COB to produce customer-facing docs.

Sam (Eng-SRE): I’ll take telemetry and runbook updates (alerts missed on the lag window). Also will coordinate the deployment window for the backfill. Tagging @Leo for metering pipeline changes.

Leo (Platform): On it. Quick check shows ingestion lag aligned with ELB restarts around 2025-11-12 02:14 UTC. I’ll propose a short-term mitigation (increase k8s min replicas to 3 + add backpressure circuit). Will open PR for pipeline resilience.

LedgerBot: Ticket FI-4277 created: "Invoice adjustments for token-count regression" assigned to Maya (Billing).

Maya (Billing): :thumbsup: I’ll draft the credit memos and a customer email template. Priya — can you confirm the language we should use?

Priya (Finance): Yes — keep it concise and apologetic, offer credits, and include the calculation appendix. I’ll draft the email and CC Legal. Draft due Tue 09:00 PT.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): For the backfill I’m planning to run the script below after logs are ready. Need a maintenance window.

```python
# one-off backfill runner
run_backfill('--date-range','2025-11-10:2025-11-12', '--dry-run')
```

Ashwin (Eng-ML): I’ve kicked off logs export to s3://redwood-metering/logs/2025-11-10-12.tar.gz — will update when counts are computed.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Suggested window for backfill: Wed 00:30–01:30 UTC (low traffic). I’ll be on-call for rollback and monitoring. Also adding a step to the runbook to compute per-customer deltas and sanity-check thresholds before issuing invoices.

Maya (Billing): Preliminary estimate of credits: ~$8.7k total for the two customers. Holding until Ashwin confirms final counts.

Priya (Finance): Action summary (I'll add to postmortem doc):
- Ashwin (Eng-ML): backfill and final token counts — owner — expected Wed EOD (confirm exact window)
- Sam (Eng-SRE): telemetry alerting and runbook updates — PR by Tue
- Leo (Platform): pipeline resilience fixes (PR + k8s replica change) — PR by Mon
- Maya (Billing): prepare invoice corrections, credit memos, and customer comms — Tue COB
I’ll consolidate and ping the execs after we have the final numbers.

Sam (Eng-SRE): Ack. I’ll add automated alert thresholds and a simple dashboard panel for ingestion lag by region.

Ashwin (Eng-ML): Ack. Starting computation now, will post CSV of per-customer deltas here when done.

LedgerBot: Reminder set: FI-4277 review in 48h.

Maya (Billing): Thanks all. If anyone needs access to billing console or sample invoice templates ping me directly.

Priya (Finance): Thanks — good progress. I’ll update the postmortem doc and action tracker with owners + dates.
